rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a biological cell, and it also refers to a small clandestine or political organization unit in that context.

example.english: This medicine can destroy a cancer cell.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 joek6 wui5 po3 waai6 ngaam4 sai3 baau1

rows.note: Use this for a mobile phone rather than for a biological or electrical cell.

example.english: I always bring a cell phone when I go out so I can contact people.
example.traditional: 我出街一定帶住手機，方便同人聯絡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 daai3 zyu6 sau2 gei1 fong1 bin6 tung4 jan4 lyun4 lok6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a battery or a battery cell.

example.english: I need to replace the cell in this toy.
example.traditional: 我要換呢部玩具嘅電池。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 wun6 ni1 bou6 wun2 geoi6 ge3 din6 ci4

rows.note: Use this for a room in a prison where inmates are kept.

example.english: They were locked in a prison cell for fighting.
example.traditional: 佢因為打交而畀人鎖咗入監房。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jan1 wai6 daa2 gaau1 ji4 bei2 jan4 so2 zo2 jap6 gaam1 fong4
